arguments.command:
cd /workspace/tmp && python3 - <<'EOF'
s=open('/app/submit/ftab.c').read()
dbg = '''        if(getenv("DBG") && (d>=60 || d<=2)) { fprintf(stderr,"d=%d m=%d kmax=%d\\n",d,m,kmax);
            for(int32_t j=0;j<m && j<3;j++){fprintf(stderr,"   j=%d totals=%llu live0=%llu cnt0=%llu\\n",j,(unsigned long long)totals[j],(unsigned long long)live[0][j],(unsigned long long)cnt[0][j]);} }
'''
marker = '        if (d == 0) {'
s = s.replace(marker, dbg + marker)
open('ftab_dbg2.c','w').write(s)
EOF
cc -O0 -g -o /workspace/tmp/ftab_dbg2 /workspace/tmp/ftab_dbg2.c && python3 - <<'EOF'
import struct, subprocess, os
entries=[(0,64)]
payload = bytearray(struct.pack('<III', 0x31424654, 8, len(entries)))
for addr,length in entries:
    payload += addr.to_bytes(16,'big'); payload.append(length)
env=dict(os.environ); env['DBG']='1'
p=subprocess.run(['/workspace/tmp/ftab_dbg2'], input=bytes(payload), stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, env=env)
print(p.stderr.decode()[-2500:])
EOF
